Criterion: Verify that critical process capability is demonstrated and that procedures for identifying, monitoring, and controlling critical process variation are in place. Standard: To be provided by the procuring agency. Method of Compliance: To be provided by the procuring agency. References: JSSG-2006: A.3.2.19.2, A.4.2.19.2; A.3.11.1; A.4.11.1.2.1 14 CFR 23.605, 25.605
